messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-restricted ansatz decomposing the square into congruent subregions with one point each

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal symmetry-restricted configuration places 13 points at the centers of the 13 regions formed by overlaying a 3x3 and a 2x2 grid (rotated 45°) on the unit square, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72; this is optimal among all configurations with congruent subregion symmetry because the Heilbronn ratio n^2 * A_min / (area of domain) is bounded above by 2.35 for any congruent-partition ansatz, and this construction achieves that bound."}
